propositions: Three diagnostic artifacts (findings document and parameterized driver scripts) were committed on branch impl-10ae-verifier-ctx but never landed on main, making a ticket citing those paths unverifiable against main

The artifacts should be landed on main because they follow an established convention in docs/experiments/, are reusable and parameterized over configurable step floors, and contain only aggregated findings (raw transcripts are external)

The completion-verifier runaway loop remains reproducible on current main despite landing the diagnostic artifacts; it clusters on certain ticket types and is caught by the runaway guard but not prevented at source

The diagnostic matrix confirms budget-anchoring behavior: verifier reaches sufficient evidence around 100 calls but continues spending surplus budget on redundant operations when given higher step floors
